name: Battle Rope Double Wave
steps: Stand in an athletic quarter-squat facing the anchor with one rope handle in each hand and palms facing inward.
Brace your core, keep your chest lifted, and relax your shoulders down away from your ears.
Whip both arms up and down together in crisp, matching strokes to send steady waves all the way to the anchor.
Maintain an even continuous cadence and grounded stance for the target duration.
tips: Keep your hips steady and resist rocking backward and forward as both ropes move together.
Drive waves all the way down the full length of the ropes with quick, rhythmic arm action.
